messages:
Maya S: heads-up — pen-test kickoff next Wed 09:00 PST. Planning to grant assessors ephemeral readroom access to pull logs + limited KMS decrypt. Need RBAC changes, audit export, and a frozen key window. cc @David L @Chris H @Assessor Sarah :wave:

David L: can we scope this to a single ephemeral role? prefer time-limited STS + least-priv. actions: s3:GetObject, kms:Decrypt only. also, when's the retest window?

Maya S: retest window planned 03/28-04/01 (flex). For RBAC, propose role name pt_assessor_role_v2 with 4h max sessions. snippet to use for IAM policy:```{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::pt-readroom/*"
}```

Chris H: Obs team — we'll need exportable CloudTrail + ALB + app logs. Please ensure CloudTrail event selectors include management and data events. retention snapshot by 03/25.

deploy-bot: scheduled export job registered -> job_id: job-20250320-7 :white_check_mark:

Alex P: key-rotation owners: we must freeze rotation during assessor window. propose freeze 03/24 -> 04/02. don't rotate primary CMKs then.

Assessor Sarah: quick Q — can you provide a small sanitized log sample before the run so we can validate parsing? Also presigned URLs for large artifacts would help.

Maya S: will upload a sanitized sample by EOD today. sample link internal: https://redwood.internal/samples/pt_log_sample_2025-03-20 (do not share externally).

David L: +1 on rotation freeze. also would like a dryrun with an internal assessor Mon 03/24 to validate perms. can eng-oncall confirm low-noise slot?

oncall-bot: dryrun slot booked 2025-03-24 10:00 PST — paging @eng-oncall.

Chris H: I'll draft an audit-export playbook and checklist. attaching checklist in Monday sync. includes steps for verifying CloudTrail integrity and SHA256 checksums.

Maya S: next steps: David to open IAM PR w/ role + session policy, Chris to prep export playbook, Alex to post rotation-freeze, I'll upload sanitized sample and presigned URL. reconvene Mon 14:00 PST for dryrun sync. :thumbsup:
